fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: a mapped reader-column value is DBNull and the target property type is not Nullable<T>
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers builds the reader-column expression for that property via ReaderNullableValueTypeExpressions
fields.response: assign the caller-supplied null-sentinel constant (expNullResult) to the property instead of the database value
fields.postcondition: when the target property type is Nullable<T> instead, a DBNull column assigns a null constant of that nullable type rather than the sentinel
